entities.summary: Kadıköy Greek Orthodox Cemetery, also known as Hasanpaşa Uzunçayır Orthodox Cemetery, is a Christian cemetery in Istanbul, Turkey. The burial ground is the final resting place of people professing the Orthodox faith in Istanbul. The cemetery is located in Kadıköy district of Istanbul just across the Doğuş University campus in Kadıköy.
